subject: MAP: next steps for MSA/DPA redlines and SLA turnaround
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP: next steps for MSA/DPA redlines and SLA turnaround

Thanks again for a productive call this morning, Olivia — appreciate the clear priorities from Acme AI. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the MAP aligned: 

- Milestone: Legal redlines for MSA & DPA + SLA confirmation
  - Responsible: Redwood legal to provide first-pass redlines; Acme legal to provide counter-redlines
  - Target turnaround: Redwood first-pass within 2 business days; Acme counter within 5 business days (open to discuss)
- Dependencies: Final scope doc (attached MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx), confirmation of who signs (procurement vs. legal)
- Target close date (commercial signature): 2026-11-19 (aiming for a 3-week negotiation cadence)

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners). Can you confirm who on your side will own the incoming redlines so we can route them to the right person? Also, do you have any internal review cycles (security or procurement) that typically add time?

Next steps: I’ll ask legal to prepare an initial clean MSA/DPA for redline (Marissa will lead). If you confirm Acme legal contact, I’ll send docs over and propose a short sync next week if helpful.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: next steps for MSA/DPA redlines and SLA turnaround

Thanks, Stephanie — this looks good. Confirming Acme legal lead is Ben Hart (cc'd). Our typical internal review: security does a quick check (1-2 business days) and procurement reviews commercial terms (adds ~3 business days depending on workload).

For turnaround expectations: would Redwood be able to do an initial redline in 5 business days, or is 2 days standard for you? We just want to align expectations against our internal procurement window.

If you can share the clean MSA/DPA/SLA doc links, Ben and I will triage and confirm the right reviewers. Happy to do a 20-minute call next Tue (Nov 2) if helpful.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product, Acme AI
olivia.chen@acmeai.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed ownership & SLA for MAP milestone (MSA/DPA redlines)

Stephanie / Marissa — following Steph's note and Acme's reply, proposing the following internal plan so we can respond with commitments: 

1) Redwood ownership: Marissa (Legal) will produce the first-pass redlines and the clean MSA/DPA/SLA documents.
   - Commitment: initial redline delivered to Acme within 2 business days after Marissa receives the MAP and final scope (we have the MAP attached).
2) Counterparty turnaround: request Acme to return counter-redlines within 5 business days (they indicated procurement/security review may add time).
3) Hand-off rules: all legal edits should go into a single redline set (Doc compare friendly). If Acme prefers, we can use Google Docs with change history but prefer track-changes in Word or a DocuSign-ready PDF for signature prep.
4) Escalation: if either side misses the agreed turnaround by 3 business days, loop in me (Rishi) to accelerate.
5) Target close date remains 2026-11-19; if we see >2 major rounds of cross-redline, we should re-baseline the MAP.

Marissa — can you confirm you can take point and whether 2 business days is realistic? Also please attach the latest clean MSA/DPA templates and note if there are any clauses you expect Acme to flag so we can preempt.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: next steps for MSA/DPA redlines and SLA turnaround

Thanks — I can take ownership of the edits on Redwood's side. Timeline: I will provide a first-pass redline within 2 business days (EOD Fri, Oct 30 PT) after confirming the final MAP scope.

Notes for Acme legal (Ben):
- We'll start with our standard MSA (attached: Redwood_MSA_Clean_v4.docx) and DPA template (attached: Redwood_DPA_Template_v2.pdf). Please review data processing additions and the liability carve-outs – those are the sections most customers comment on.
- Preferred workflow: send redlines back in a single Word file with tracked changes or a consolidated PDF with comments. That keeps versioning simple.
- Turnaround expectations: 2 business days for Redwood first-pass; we request 5 business days for your counter so we can maintain the MAP cadence. If Acme needs longer, flag now and we'll adjust the target close.

I have also added the SLA doc link below for your review (performance SLAs + credits). If you have specific SLO numbers you need, list them in the reply and we can include them in the redline.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
